# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not publish exploit details, credentials, or personal information in a public issue. Use GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** option in the repository's Security tab so the maintainer can review the report privately. If private vulnerability reporting is unavailable, contact the maintainer through [GitHub](https://github.com/SMMahmudIqbal) and include the affected repository, version or commit, impact, and minimal reproduction steps. Do not include live secrets or real personal data in the report.

## Supported Versions

Unless a repository documents a longer support window, security fixes are made to the latest default-branch version. Older releases may no longer receive updates.
